If you're like me, you've probably spent hours diving deep into Wikipedia's random articles, falling further and further down the rabbit hole. Now there's finally an official app... well, technically a widget.

Finally, a button that takes you straight to a random Wikipedia article

Today's Wikipedia iOS app update adds a fun and practical new feature: a "Random Article" widget that can be placed on the home screen of your iPhone or iPad.

The widget comes in small and medium sizes, and features a cute mascot to keep you company.

Tap the widget and you'll be taken directly to a completely random Wikipedia article, with random mode automatically enabled.

No need to leave the app and tap the widget again — just hit the random button and it'll roll the dice for you, sending you to another article as you continue to venture deeper into this random world.

Enjoy it slowly, but be careful not to lose track of time! Earlier this summer, Wikipedia's app already added a historical trivia quiz game.

You can access this new widget in today's Wikipedia iPhone and iPad app update.

Make the most of your Apple devices
